query: How will synthetic k-space manipulations and artifact simulations be parameterized and validated against held-out real-site scans to ensure realistic domain-shift benchmarks?

response.query: How will synthetic k-space manipulations and artifact simulations be parameterized and validated against held-out real-site scans to ensure realistic domain-shift benchmarks?
response.answer: Synthetic k-space manipulations and artifact simulations will be parameterized using statistical models and validated against held-out real-site scans through cross-validation and quantitative metrics like PSNR and SSIM. Domain-shift benchmarks will ensure realistic comparisons.
